what: Once the top edge of the list crosses the 25% line from the bottom of the screen, one time — the card photo swells from .84 scale and transparent to 1.06 at 38%, then bounces .98 → 1.02 → 1 and settles (.6s cubic-bezier(0,0,.58,1), each card .2s later). The attached category pill and title (after) turn on .4s later over .32s. With look: label, the section-heading pill bounces once after .72s 1 → 1.06 → .98 → 1.02 → 1 (.48s)

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Slot that pops out (card photo slot)
options.[data-fx-part=after]: Text that turns on late within a cell (optional)
options.delay: First delay (seconds), default 0 · look: label is .72
options.after: How much the accompanying text lags behind the cell (s), default .4
options.look: With label, the element itself bounces once with a thump while already in place
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease · --fx-after-dur: Bounce duration (.6s · label .48s) · curve · text turn-on (.32s)
